notes.title: Patch Update: Matchmaking & Balance
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a new update packed with [b]features, fixes, and balance changes[/b] to keep your matches fresh and competitive. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h2]FEATURES[/h2][list][*][p]Matchmaking improvements for smoother, fairer matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now always have a [b]guaranteed 150-gold quest per day[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Rerolling a quest now always gives another quest with the [b]same reward value[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Card Upgrade Progression[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Harder to upgrade any [b]Epic or lower-rarity card[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Much easier to upgrade any [b]Legendary or Mythic card[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Mervena can no longer be played if your opponent played a [i]Doomed Spy[/i] on your board and sacrificed it on their last turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: The [i]"Win Ranked Games"[/i] quest now correctly works if your opponent surrenders.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2][p][b]BASIC UNIT (Buff)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Restless – Threefold: ATK 1 ➝ 2, Undying 1 ➝ 2[/p][/*][/list][p][b]COMMON HERO (Buff)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pachys The Cripple: All allies with up to 2 ➝ 3 ATK gain +3 ATK[/p][/*][/list][p][b]COMMON UNITS (Buffs)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Kauwn the Just: Strike 1 ➝ 2[/p][/*][*][p]Deathsert Bandit – Ambusher: Banish 2 ➝ 1 cards, gained ability [i]Execute 2[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]COMMON SPELL (Nerf)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shatter Morale: Return a card with up to 10 ATK to the owner’s hand. Cost increase 2 ➝ 1 (max. 6)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UNCOMMON UNITS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fuuri Igniter: Cost 4 ➝ 5 (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Noma Jhah: ATK 6 ➝ 4 (Nerf)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UNCOMMON SPELL (Buff)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rain Fire: Damage 4 ➝ 5[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UNCOMMON HEROES (Nerfs)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zirg the Unstoppable: Base Strike 2 ➝ 1[/p][/*][*][p]Fiera Olrac Ardnassak: ATK 4 ➝ 2[/p][/*][/list][p][b]RARE UNIT (Nerf)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vile Guard – Unleashed: ATK 14 ➝ 12[/p][/*][/list][p][b]EPIC UNITS & HEROES[/b][/p][list][*][p]True Face of Loyalty: Up to 8 ATK ➝ up to 6 ATK (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Mervena: Cost 2 ➝ 3 (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Beata The Tester: Bots slightly weaker. Strike 2 ➝ 1, Protection CD 2 ➝ 3, Looter CD 2 ➝ 3 (Nerf)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]LEGENDARY HEROES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ane: Recruits now cost 0 (Buff)[/p][/*][*][p]Ashen Anuran: Cost 8 ➝ 10 (Nerf)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]MYTHIC HEROES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Emperor Darteanesh: ATK 8 ➝ 6 (Nerf)[/p][/*][*][p]Zedrax, Wrath of the Council: Now only prevents playing [b]UNITS[/b] and [b]HEROES[/b] that don’t cost 5. Players can now cast [b]SPELLS[/b] while this card is on the field (Buff).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Did you get here? Here is a gold code for first 100 readers! [/p][p][b]PROMO CODE: Gg5l9o4[/b][/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for this patch!
As always, thank you for playing and keep sending us your feedback — it helps us improve Dfiance every step of the way.[/p][p]– The Dfiance Team[/p]

notes.title: Tournaments are coming back to Dfiance!
notes.notes: [p]Hi guys![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve heard you loud and clear — [b]tournaments[/b] are one of the features our community loves the most, and we’re thrilled to announce that they’re returning to the game very soon![/p][p][/p][p][b]What does this mean?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Daily & Weekly Events[/b] – We’ll be running tournaments for different time zones so players from all over the world can join.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prizes for Participants & Winners[/b] – Whether you place first or just take part, there’s something to be earned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Open to Everyone[/b] – Your rank, time spent in-game, or card collection size doesn’t matter — tournaments are about skill, strategy, and just a bit of luck with your draws.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]This is your chance to put your decks to the test, meet new players, and maybe even walk away with some bragging rights (and rewards).[/p][p]Stay tuned for the exact schedule and prize details — we’ll be sharing them very soon.[/p][p][/p][p]– The Dfiance Team[/p]

notes.title: 🇫🇷 Bonjour, French language support is here!

[p][b]HI GUYS! [/b]ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]Today’s update brings a handful of exciting changes — and the biggest one is that [b]Dfiance is now available in French[/b]! We know many of you have been asking for it, and we’re thrilled to finally bring it to life. Head to your settings to switch languages and enjoy the full experience in French![/p][p]That’s not all:[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🔧 General Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]New art has been added for several cards: [b]Aznas Brave[/b], [b]Khaos[/b], [b]Void[/b], [b]Sigtur Son of the Mountain[/b], and [b]Beata the Tester[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]French[/b] has been added as a language option.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Beata the Tester[/b] is now officially a [b]HERO[/b] (Epic Hero, rework).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lancer Daghmund[/b] (Basic Unit) has been nerfed: Cost increased from [b]3 → 4[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Corynia[/b] (Rare Hero) has been nerfed: ATK reduced from [b]4 → 3[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pachys The Cripple[/b] (Common Hero) has been buffed: Cost reduced from [b]3 → 2[/b], ATK reduced from [b]5 → 2[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve also made buffs to several [b]underused cards[/b] to give them a fighting chance in the current meta.[/p][p][/p][p] Full patch notes are available in the official Discord — and we're always listening, so feel free to drop your feedback there.[/p][p]Merci & see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Lost Connection Issue — fix
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]We know many of you have been experiencing issues with lost connections and getting thrown out of matches — and we hear your frustration.[/p][p]The good news is: after digging through the logs and monitoring live reports, we've managed to track down the root cause of the main connection bug. A fix is already being implemented and should (we hope so!) prevent these disconnections moving forward. [/p][p]We’re deeply sorry for how this affected your gameplay, especially during launch.
[/p][p]We’ve also been carefully reading all of your feedback — thank you for being so vocal. It’s helping us prioritize what matters most to the community.[/p][p]Over the next few weeks, expect a series of updates aimed at improving:[/p][list][*][p]overall game stability[/p][/*][*][p]account progression speed[/p][/*][*][p]deck-building and card access[/p][/*][*][p]and other quality-of-life fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]We're also discussing a [b]global compensation[/b] for players impacted by the recent bugs. We’ll announce more details about that as soon as it's finalized (on Discord).[/p][p]Thanks again for your patience and support.
We're not going anywhere — and Dfiance will only get better from here.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dfiance is now LIVE on Steam!

[p][b]Dfiance is now LIVE on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We’re officially launching — and the battlefield is open to everyone. notes.title: RANKED SEASONS - UPCOMING CHANGES
notes.notes: [h2]Dfiance now has Ranked Seasons. (starting 21.07 in browser and 04.08 on Steam)[/h2][p][/p][p] Players climb through the ranks, starting from Bronze IV, all the way through Silver, Gold, Emerald, Legendary, Mythic and unlikely Titan tier, receive rewards and keep pushing constantly for eternal glory.[/p][p][/p][p]  At the end of each [b]Season[/b], players are rewarded with awesome cosmetics based on how well they performed. When a [b]Season[/b] ends, player rewards and collected cards are moved to their Eternal slot.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592994/1d5c0da0a42ed2fc16b89a0a58767ffb85aa237a.png"][/img][/p][p] When a new Season begins, player ELOs and Ranked collections are reset — allowing for a fresh start and giving new players a fair chance to compete in upcoming Seasons. [/p][p][/p][p]New Seasons can also introduce game-changing mechanics, such as [b]new factions[/b]. [/p][p]All cards collected during seasons, including player’s pre-season collections, continue to be available in the Eternal deck. [/p][p][/p][p]Players will keep all the cards they have, but they won’t be able to use them in Ranked matches, only in Casual, specific tournaments and friendly matches (upcoming). [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592994/3a42546b3cc85c0cf16533260662dcbada9e97ee.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DFIANCE RELEASE - OFFICIAL DATE
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p]We know many of you are eagerly waiting for Dfiance to launch on Steam — and soon after, on Android.
After careful discussions with the dev team, we’ve decided to [b]schedule the Steam release to August 4[/b].[/p][p]
That said, we won’t leave you hanging — [b]on July 21, we’ll release a PRE-SEASON version in the browser[/b], where you can test all the upcoming features before they go live on Steam.[/p][p][b]Starting today until the end of the week[/b], we'll be sharing the changes one by one in the Discord rodamap channel so everyone can see what’s coming and share feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your patience and support — we’re building this for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592994/86c9d10849b467267b2275b4e98ce91896f555c9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Dfiance Demo Stays – Until Full Release
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Thanks so much for all the support during Steam Next Fest — it means a lot to our small team.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve got some good news:
The [b]Dfiance demo will remain available on Steam[/b] all the way until the [b]full version launches[/b] later this year.[/p][p][/p][p]We want new players to still have a chance to try the game and see what Dfiance is all about.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, please note:
The demo [b]won’t be receiving updates[/b], as we continue to focus on improving and expanding the [b]browser version[/b], which will evolve into the full release.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to drop feedback, wishlist the game, and join the community ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]— Team Dfiance[/p][p][/p]
